written_by: Claude, from the film's narration (Voice Transcribe) before running the pipeline. Not a trainer's list; test data only.

steps.text: Check the tires: inflation of pneumatic tires correct and tires in good condition.
Check that all running lights are working.
Check the forward and reverse mechanism.
Check the lift and tilt controls.
Check that the forks or other load-engaging devices work properly.
With the forklift shut down, visually check the hydraulic hoses for pinch points and worn spots.
Check the chains, making sure the cotter pins are in place; never use bare hands.
Check that the brakes work properly.
Check that the steering mechanism is okay.
Check that the fuel system is operational.
Record the inspection in the forklift's inspection log.
